scripts.update: cd lovetap && git pull && docker compose up -d --build app
scripts.oikb:sync: bash -c "set -a; source ./.env; set +a; OPEN_WEBUI_URL=\"$OIKB_SERVER_URL\" OPEN_WEBUI_API_KEY=\"$OIKB_API_KEY\" oikb sync . --kb-id \"$OIKB_KNOWLEDGE_ID\""
scripts.oikb:watch: bash -c "set -a; source ./.env; set +a; OPEN_WEBUI_URL=\"$OIKB_SERVER_URL\" OPEN_WEBUI_API_KEY=\"$OIKB_API_KEY\" oikb watch . --kb-id \"$OIKB_KNOWLEDGE_ID\""
